# ShellSage

> ShellSage is an AI-powered command-line assistant that helps developers and shell users get instant, context-aware answers and execute shell commands — leveraging the current terminal session history, file system, and web search as live context.

A Python CLI tool (`ssage`) built on top of the Claude/LLM API via the `lisette` library, providing an interactive REPL and single-shot query modes with optional tool-use permissions and reasoning support.
